subject: Infinite Nature kickoff - perpetual scenes from a single photo
body:
Team,

Kicking off Infinite Nature. Our open-source release does perpetual view generation - fly into a single RGB image of a natural scene and keep generating plausible landscape forever. It's the most demo-able thing in the vision portfolio, and that's the plan: a polished interactive experience (built off the release's HTML frontend concept) as the centerpiece of our June external demo slot, pending Launch Review Board.

Scope: get the released model running in our serving environment, retrain on our licensed aerial-coastline corpus so the external demo isn't leaning on third-party data, and harden the interactive frontend. Umar owns the model work, Kaia generation quality, Farah serving integration, Oyin the frontend.

Milestones: local pipeline reproduced by early April, retraining through May, LRB submission and demo freeze by 2026-06-22.

Deshawn - resourcing note please, including the TPU ask for retraining.

Lucia
